title: U.S. household financial assets
definition: Official FIN: transaction accounts, CDs, pooled investment funds, stocks, bonds, retirement accounts, savings bonds, cash-value life insurance, other managed assets and other financial assets. Excludes nonfinancial assets; debts are not subtracted.

source.name: Federal Reserve Survey of Consumer Finances

method: Weighted empirical CDF, at or below; average of five separately normalized weighted CDFs using extract WGT (already X42001/5). No interpolation across point masses.
